'''''Heroes Of The Republic''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] [[Writing/Legends|written]] by [[Madelein Aurin]] and published by [[Sarlain Star Press]]. It included an interview with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Haaran Balmor]]. The book was eventually banned by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
